title: Spyglass: Officially Launched
summary: Spyglass has officially launched, bringing its powerful insights and capabilities to all users for an enhanced experience.

title: Enhanced File Management & Display Options
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your embedded files with new management tools and flexible display modes in the editor.

title: Product Roadmap Now Live
summary: Discover our new public roadmap, offering complete transparency into recently shipped features, what's coming next, and exciting future plans.

title: Elevated Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a more seamless and intuitive experience with our newly redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable.

title: Enhanced Editor Collaboration Tools
summary: We've refined our editor's collaboration features, making it even easier and more intuitive to work together with your team.

title: Enhanced Discovery and Collaboration for Shared Items
summary: This feature makes it significantly easier to discover and work together on all the items you share with others, ensuring you never miss valuable collaborative opportunities.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We are adding support for many international languages to make Noeko accessible to users worldwide.

title: Open Source Noeko
summary: We're opening Noeko's codebase to empower our community with greater control, direct involvement in development, and full transparency.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Navigate your entire knowledge base with unprecedented clarity, using powerful new filters to reveal hidden connections and personalized insights in your Constellation view.

title: Smart Search & Personalized Knowledge Collections
summary: Effortlessly find and organize your information with powerful new filtering, sorting, and saving capabilities, allowing you to create tailored collections for any topic.

title: Customizable Note Views
summary: Experience a more intuitive and personalized note-taking flow with new display options that better reflect how you think and organize information.

title: Unleash Noeko: Self-Hosting and Flexible Paid Plans
summary: Experience new levels of control and value as we introduce Noeko's self-hosting options and flexible paid plans for individuals and enterprises.

title: Elevated Themes & Vibrant New Options
summary: Get ready for a stunning visual upgrade with polished existing themes and a collection of vibrant new design choices to perfectly match your style.

title: Personalized Welcome Messages
summary: We are enhancing your experience with smarter, time-sensitive greetings on the homepage, ensuring a perfectly personalized welcome no matter when you log in.

title: Streamlined Content Curation
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content with new bulk actions that let you unapply tags, delete items, and access details right from your tag view.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Get ready to seamlessly incorporate insights from a wider array of content, including websites, YouTube videos, and text files, empowering you to build a truly comprehensive knowledge base.
